description:
Bajaj Broking MCP Connector brings your trading and portfolio information into OpenAI-compatible MCP experiences. It let's users securely search instruments, view funds and margins, check holdings and open positions, review today’s orders and trades, fetch real-time market quotes, and retrieve historical OHLC chart data.
 
The connector is designed to give users useful market and account context while keeping access controlled. It helps investors and traders ask natural-language questions about their Bajaj Broking account and market data without switching between multiple screens.
 
This connector is especially useful for users who want faster portfolio visibility, cleaner trade review, and easier access to market context directly inside their AI workflow.

defaultPrompt: Fetch my holdings, open positions 2. Get available funds 3. Give a concise briefing with PNL summary.
Get live market quote and research for a symbol.
